configuration_map: No spatial configuration exists. The proof deals entirely with commensurability relations between straight line magnitudes (a, b, c, d, r). The only construction is cutting length b from line a to obtain remainder d = a - b (via I.3), which is a one-dimensional operation with no spatial ambiguity. All reasoning concerns algebraic classification: whether magnitudes are rational, commensurable in square only, or commensurable in length, and whether the resulting apotome satisfies the definition of a second apotome.
